parameters.query:
SELECT q.*,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= $1::timestamptz)::int AS new_this_run
FROM search_queries q
WHERE NOT q.done
ORDER BY q.id
LIMIT 1;

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT * FROM json_to_recordset($1::json) AS x(
    dedupe_key text, name text, category text, address text, city text, phone text, website text, email text)
),
fresh AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (dedupe_key) * FROM incoming i
  WHERE dedupe_key <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM leads l WHERE l.dedupe_key = i.dedupe_key)
),
ins AS (
  INSERT INTO leads (dedupe_key, name, category, address, city, phone, website, email, query_id)
  SELECT dedupe_key, name, category, address, city, phone, website, email, $3::int
  FROM fresh LIMIT $4::int
  ON CONFLICT (dedupe_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING 1
),
used_whole_page AS (SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM fresh) <= $4::int AS yes)
UPDATE search_queries SET
  next_token  = CASE WHEN (SELECT yes FROM used_whole_page) THEN $2::text ELSE next_token END,
  done        = CASE WHEN (SELECT yes FROM used_whole_page) THEN $2::text = '' ELSE false END,
  total_found = total_found + (SELECT count(*) FROM incoming),
  total_new   = total_new + (SELECT count(*) FROM ins),
  last_run_at = now()
WHERE id = $3::int
RETURNING id AS query_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM ins)::int AS added, done;
